translations.web: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.
translations.bsb: The words of his mouth are wicked and deceitful; he has ceased to be wise and well-doing.
translations.kjv: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, and to do good.
translations.asv: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: He hath ceased to be wise and to do good.
